question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4) i.e. 'importance'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Trees play **a crucial role** in supporting life and maintaining ecological balance, highlighting their **importance**.
 
• The context implies the value trees hold for living beings and the environment, making 'importance' the contextually fit choice.
 
• The term '**importance**' connects logically to the benefits trees provide, as listed following the blank.

**Therefore, the correct answer is 'importance'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• '**Revolution**' implies a dramatic change.
 
• '**Transformation**' refers to a marked change in form or appearance.
 
• '**Renovation**' means restoring something old to a good state.

**Complete Passage is**: Trees are one of the gifts of the nature which are of great** ****importance**__ for all living beings and environment. They have ______ benefits to living beings providing natural herbs, vegetables, fruits, wood, timber, etc. Trees are the ______ of many birds and insects. They are also considered as the ______ part of the atmosphere which help in reducing pollution. Conserving trees and spreading awareness to plant trees will save the atmosphere from depletion and ______ survival of all forms on earth.
